scripts.build:android: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/catalog.ts android && WEFT_PLATFORM=android vite build
scripts.build:ios: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/catalog.ts ios && WEFT_PLATFORM=ios vite build
scripts.build:linux: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/catalog.ts linux && WEFT_PLATFORM=linux vite build
scripts.build:macos: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/catalog.ts macos && WEFT_PLATFORM=macos vite build
scripts.build:web: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/catalog.ts web && WEFT_PLATFORM=web vite build
scripts.build:wechat: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/catalog.ts wechat && WEFT_PLATFORM=wechat vite build
scripts.build:windows: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/catalog.ts windows && WEFT_PLATFORM=windows vite build
scripts.test:ios: xcodebuild test -project apps/ios/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=${WEFT_IOS_DEVICE:-iPhone 17}" -derivedDataPath apps/ios/build
scripts.test:macos: xcodebuild test -project apps/macos/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -destination platform=macOS -derivedDataPath apps/macos/build
